items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Dropdown select on Base UI Select: square trigger, portal popup, rows with a dark left-to-right fill wipe, arrow cursor, square bullet and thin rules; groups, separators and disabled items.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Square Enix or PlatinumGames. Compose Select, SelectTrigger, SelectValue, SelectContent, SelectItem (plus SelectGroup, SelectGroupLabel, SelectSeparator). Pass `items` to Select so the closed trigger can show the selected label. Disabled items stay keyboard-highlightable (Base UI behaviour) but cannot be chosen. Popup uses yorha-pop; optional SelectArrow, SelectBackdrop and SelectLabel parts; the list scrolls inside the popup with scroll arrows. Reduced motion is opacity-only, off is instant. v4 (yorha-v4/f-sel-a): `clearable` on <Select>: Backspace / Delete on the closed trigger clears to the placeholder (null, [] with `multiple`; ignored when `required`). An uncontrolled select now returns to `defaultValue` on form reset (Base UI alone kept the pick); `name` and `required` post / validate natively through Base UI's hidden input. Select stays on Base UI Select, not <select>: the UA list popup cannot be themed outside Chromium base-select. Arrow is a pixel triangle glyph stack (no rotation). Migration: `Select` is a function wrapper (value is controlled internally); registryDependencies add @yorha/glyph.
